correctness.rationale: The closed-form two-regime parameter matrices satisfy every defining halfspace and are positive definite. The n+1 or n+2 explicitly weighted unit contact normals obey the exact John moment identities, certifying global optimality and uniqueness for all real 0<=t<1, n>=2. Inequalities on reflected vertex supports determine the unique Minkowski center; maximizing the quadratic ellipsoid norm at a polytope vertex gives the exact rounding factor. Saved-package checker ran 258 exact rational tests and 4601 randomly feasible symmetric competitors; these are supplementary to the analytical proof.

value.rationale: A complete and natural simplex-truncation family exhibits a new active-facet transition at (n-1)/(n+1): the John ellipsoid is stationary then changes shape while a unique Minkowski center moves continuously from the start. Exact contact weights and John-specific containment show how this geometrically canonical ellipsoid responds to a first facet cut. The interior regime is not a mere endpoint substitution, and it gives useful explicit test bodies for ellipsoidal rounding and asymmetry.
